concept: DynamoDB DAX: in-memory cache for repeated reads
tests: How to cut latency to microseconds and reduce the cost of repeated reads of the same DynamoDB items.
expected: Add a DAX cluster — a write-through cache in front of DynamoDB, microsecond latency, offloads RCUs. Triggers: "sub-millisecond / microsecond", "repeated reads of the same items", "read costs high".
why_not: Global tables — multi-Region replication, not a cache; on-demand changes the billing model, not latency; a GSI — a new access pattern, not caching.
